main_text.head: VENERANDÆ FACULT. THEOL. BASILIENSIS Proceribus:
main_text.p: DN. SEBASTIANO BECKIO, S. Theol. D. ac Nov. Test. Profess. meritiss. Facult. p. t. Decano dignissimo:
DN. THEODORO ZVINGERO, S. Th. D. &c. Compatri atque Promotori suo honoratissimo:
DN. JOHANNI BUXTORFIO, S. Theol. D. Ling. S. itemque Locc. Comm. & Controv. Theol. Profess. celeberrimo:
Præsentem hancce Dissertationem In ὀρθοδοξίας π[?]ερὶ καὶ ὁμοδοξίας suæ publicum testamentum,

p.i: Qui, si quid Ecclesiæ DEI utile novit, hoc ad ipsorum pedes se didicisse, ingenuè agnoscit ac profitetur,

page.notes: The Greek line is hard to read: the word after ὀρθοδοξίας and the word ὁμοδοξίας are uncertain, and the reading of the Greek preposition is a guess. The ornamental border, a library stamp at top right and show-through from the facing page are not transcribed. The printed word "Præsentem" is in italic; "hancce" and "In" are in roman type as the layout suggests.
